message.content: Starting with broad random sweeps, then targeting rare corners.
Found a violation early — shrinking it to the minimal case.
Shrunk to a short emergency case — confirming it replays and inspecting the failure.
Replay confirmed — now gathering step evidence.
First violating step shows NS green — checking the full timeline to trace the switch.
Violation involves skipped clearance — inspecting the steps before the preemption.
Ledger: emergency preemption appears to truncate yellow and skip all-red (yellow 1s vs 6s needed, clearance 0s vs 2s). Ruling out fixed-time cycling by testing the same scene without the emergency.
Counterfactual passes — submitting the grounded report.
